plan: Same six as E0249 attempt 2 and E0251, re-ordered only. Mega Swampert is moved to the back because Ogerpon's Ivy Cudgel is Grass-type and Water/Ground is 4x to Grass; leading it would hand Lorenzo a free OHKO. Garchomp and Excadrill lead: Earthquake is 2x into Nidoqueen, Excadrill resists Zangoose's Normal damage, and neither is weak to Ivy Cudgel. Alakazam's Psychic is 2x into Nidoqueen and Shadow Ball 2x into Starmie; Azumarill's Knock Off is 2x into Starmie.
